quote.text: How do I stop a shop doing work I didn't authorize

promise.text: What to tell a mechanic before work starts

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "mechanic", "shop"

lines.text: Describe the symptom, agree the diagnostic fee and set an approval boundary before leaving your car.
Keep the estimate and final invoice together.

items.text: Identify the vehicle by year, model, plate and current odometer reading.
Describe the onset, frequency and conditions: cold start, braking, turning, speed or weather.
Name the jobs you authorize, the total limit and the contact method.
Read the work order before signing.

line.text: Hand them a dated, mileage-stamped page saying what you are requesting today and that nothing else is authorized without a conversation first.

title.text: What to tell a mechanic before work starts
